heading: Start here — your first 2 hours
definition: What MechaLab is: this course's browser workbench. Python 3.12 and the circuit simulators run inside the tab, with nothing to install and no account needed. An account is optional, for carrying progress between devices.
linkLabel: Read Lesson 1: Variables and data types →
note: When to use it: any time a lesson asks you to run something — Run Python Lessons lists every lesson and exercise that has an entry. Read the page for the idea, then type, run and verify in MechaLab; your progress stays in this browser unless you sign in, and nothing is saved on GitHub.
